description: Its going to be all vibes and fun.
summary: we developed a junior astronaut mission trainer. There are two destinations either moon or mars, whichever the user or player selects it will lead to four categories necessary for survival power, shield, food and air. Now the player has to maintain those in such a way that the astronauts survive. Each astronaut can commit to 2 hours upto 8 hours a day and there are 15 days.
details:
Outpost Commander is a story-driven mission trainer for children aged 7 to 12. The player commands a Moon or Mars outpost for 15 days. Each day they split 8 crew hours across Power, Air, Food, Shield and Science, then watch the base react.

The story is told in short chapters where the crew asks the player to make choices, and every choice has a cost. Solar storms, air leaks and late cargo ships test the plan. On Mars, warnings from Earth often arrive too late because of the radio delay.

The game teaches planning ahead, managing limited resources and what astronauts need to survive. Each day shows a real space fact, and the menu links to NASA DONKI, Artemis, Mars and NASA STEM pages.

It is built with HTML, CSS and vanilla JavaScript, with no libraries, and is deployed on Vercel. There are no accounts, no personal data and no tracking. It includes a How to play guide, light and dark themes, and keyboard controls.

What makes it creative: players learn by running the mission, not by reading. Colours run from red to blue so young players can see risk at a glance, and a failed mission still brings the crew home safely so they can try again.
